user.title: Modbus Slave
user.description: Home Assistant will answer Modbus TCP requests for this slave ID on this port.

data_description.host: IP address of this Home Assistant to listen on. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces.
data_description.allowed_ips: IP addresses or ranges (CIDR) that may connect, separated by commas, e.g. 192.168.1.10, 10.0.5.0/24. Leave empty to allow everyone.
data_description.share_usage: Ticked by default; untick to send nothing. Every 6 hours, sends only a random installation ID and the version of this integration, so active installations and versions can be counted; the server adds the country. Never addresses, entities, mappings or values. [Privacy policy]({privacy_url})

error.port_in_use: Port is in use or the address cannot be opened. Ports below 1024 need extra privileges on Container/Core installs; pick e.g. 5020. The listen address must belong to this Home Assistant.
error.invalid_allowed_ips: Use IP addresses or ranges like 192.168.1.10 or 10.0.5.0/24, separated by commas.

abort.already_configured: This port is already used by another Modbus Slave entry.

confirm.title: {entity}
confirm.description: Detected: {summary}. Change the type if needed. Scale and signed only apply to scaled16. Writable: anyone who can reach this port can control this entity. Modbus TCP has no authentication.

error.unsupported_entity: This entity has no on/off or numeric state.
error.type_mismatch: Use 'bit' for on/off entities and a numeric type for numeric entities.
error.not_writable: This entity cannot be controlled with this type. Writable: switch, light, input_boolean, fan (bit); number, input_number (numeric).
error.address_overlap: Address range overlaps the mapping of {conflict}.
